violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASHING HANDS IN FOOD PREP-SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED AND WASHED HER HANDS IN THE HANDWASHING SINK.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED BOBA AT 91F ON THE COUNTER (1HR).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED ON HOT HOLDING. BOBA PUT IN FREEZER TO RAPID COOL.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: IN TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP: CUT CANTALOUPE AT 50F, CUT WATERMELON AT 50F, MILK AT 46F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: DISPOSED OF.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED FRUIT FLIES THROUGHOUT THE STALL.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. OBTAIN PEST CONTROL AND HAVE THEM TREAT FACILITY FOR FLIES. SEND ME THE REPORT BY JULY 31ST.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP AT 53F HOLDING FOOD 46-5F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE HAVE THIS COOLER REPAIRED/ADJUSTED TO HOLD FOOD AT 41F OR BELOW. IT SHOULD BE SET AROUND 35F. PLEASE CORRECT THIS BY JULY 31ST.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. Person in charge disposed of spray pesticides

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: Observed in the facility, no hand thermometer for foods
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. Person in charge retrieved the thermometer and replaced it in the facility.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: Facility person in charge with using coordinate money test kit for bleach based sanitizer solution.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a @BLEACH, QUATERNARY AMMONIA, IODINE@ test kit. Person in charge acquired a chlorine sanitizer test kit
